scripts.build: npm run build:browser && npm run build:decky && npm run build:millennium
scripts.release: npm test && npm run build:decky && npm run typecheck && python scripts/package-release.py && python scripts/make-privacy-page.py
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p decky/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p millennium/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build:browser && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && python tests/test_decky.py
